title: The EU General Court dismisses Apple's legal challenges against its designation as a DMA "gatekeeper" for its App Store and iOS; Apple filed the case in 2024 (Foo Yun Chee/Reuters)
commentary: Apple's legal attempt to escape DMA gatekeeper status fails at the first judicial hurdle — the General Court wasn't buying it. Brussels now has cleaner runway to enforce App Store and iOS obligations without waiting out years of Apple-preferred litigation delays.
